const SERIAL = 1 as const;

// CASE ts_type_args expect=fire
export async function a1(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, 1, op);
}

// CASE ts_module_const_as_const expect=fire
export async function a2(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit(items, SERIAL, op);
}

// CASE ts_typed_local expect=fire
export async function a3(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const width: number = 1;
	await mapLimit(items, width, op);
}

// CASE ts_satisfies expect=fire
export async function a4(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	await mapLimit(items, 1 satisfies number, op);
}

// CASE ts_honest_param expect=pass
export async function h1(
	items: string[],
	op: (s: string) => Promise<void>,
	width: number,
) {
	await mapLimit<string>(items, width, op);
}
